full_modulus_fourth_power_theorem.mod_Bp: C is a fourth power in (Z/B^p Z)^times because A^4=C^q and gcd(q,4)=1
full_modulus_fourth_power_theorem.mod_Cq: -B is a fourth power in (Z/C^q Z)^times because A^4=(-B)^p and gcd(p,4)=1

global_impact.advance: one uniform theorem replaces signature-by-signature residue-symbol calculations and couples B,C through one full-modulus parameter
global_impact.core: every canonical one-four Beal signature (4,p,q) with distinct odd primes
global_impact.remaining_gap: the conditions are necessary and uniform but no global contradiction or complete descent is yet proved

nonclaim: This theorem advances the complete infinite one-four core but does not eliminate it and does not prove Beal.

branches.condition: B is congruent to C modulo 8

scope.exponents: coprime odd positive integers p,q (in the canonical Beal core, distinct odd primes)

source_dependencies: none; the theorem is elementary group arithmetic plus parity
